title: Deref Coercion
goal: Pass boxed values directly into functions expecting borrowed references.
hints: Rust automatically coerces references to smart pointers into references to their target type.
Dereferencing *b1 attempts to move the unsized str value out of the box.
explanation: Rust implements Deref for Box, allowing deref coercion to convert &Box<str> or &Box<String> automatically into &str when passing arguments to count_words. Attempting to dereference *b1 fails because str is dynamically sized and cannot be moved (E0277). Passing b1 without borrowing produces a type mismatch error (E0308) because count_words expects &str rather than an owned Box.
